query:
SELECT 
  'Branch 20 - June Sales' as metric,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(totalSaleValue) as total_value,
  SUM(profit) as total_profit,
  MIN(createdAt) as min_date,
  MAX(createdAt) as max_date
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE branchId = 20 AND DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Branch 20 - June Inventory' as metric,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(price * quantity) as total_value,
  0 as total_profit,
  MIN(createdAt) as min_date,
  MAX(createdAt) as max_date
FROM inventory
WHERE branchId = 20 AND DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Branch 60015 - June Sales' as metric,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(totalSaleValue) as total_value,
  SUM(profit) as total_profit,
  MIN(createdAt) as min_date,
  MAX(createdAt) as max_date
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE branchId = 60015 AND DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Branch 60015 - June Inventory' as metric,

  SUM(price * quantity) as total_value,
  0 as total_profit,
  MIN(createdAt) as min_date,
  MAX(createdAt) as max_date
FROM inventory
WHERE branchId = 60015 AND DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06';
